usageNote: 过去时短语，说小时候的回忆超好用！trip比travel更口语，感觉是短途玩耍那种~

examples.en: He went on trips with his parents every summer when he was a child.
examples.zh: 他小时候每年夏天都会和父母一起去旅行。

examples.en: She learned a lot about history because she went on trips with her parents to old cities.
examples.zh: 她对历史了解很多，因为她曾和父母去古城旅行。
